notes.title: Localization support
notes.content:
The demo doesn't include this update as it's only applied to the paid version.

Added support for the following languages:


Japanese.


Spanish.


Portuguese.


Chinese.


Russian.


 It may not be perfect, as certain things might not be inserted perfectly, but I've been trying to get this game localized in new languages for a while. It's more so a better tool for importing was released recently that prevents unexpected crashes. Now it runs without any problems with importing, along with easier management of localization versions.

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content: This update focuses on increasing the performance overall.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Added an option to read up more about each class before choosing one, and adding a warning that it cannot change when chosen. More to this will be added in the future so it's much more specific. 
 Removed mouse view fully
 Removed the Notebook functionality for now, as it's not working as intended.
 Added some rocks and other stuff in the main town to make it easier to navigate.
 Changed certain quest items to have 0 worth for reselling.
 Fixed some stuff with food.
 Changed the area effect for NPCs, so it's very visible at all times where a friendly NPC is.


Somethings for the post processing is an engine problem, I have to wait for the devs of the engine to implement that feature at this point.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed the demo lock appearing in the full game
Fixed certain fire events from happening more than once.
Changed how one NPC operates.
Added a warning in the tamer tutorial. (It uses the attack of the enemy with Kestral's defense to determine an attack when an enemy does a sneak attack while the player cannot counter it).

notes.title: Tamer Mode added
notes.content:
Tamer Mode
In this brand new game mode, instead of controlling 6 party members, you only control one. But you get a special ability to start negotiations with enemies to recruit them into your party. It's a brand new way to play.
This mode contains:

In depth negotiation system to talk to and recruit monsters to your party.
58 different enemies to recruit.
New fire side discussions with each monster.
Reworked events for this mode.
Gameplay rebalancing for this mode.
 Reworked the Hardcore and Suffering difficulties for this new mode

notes.content: Fixed a weird bug with swapping that doesn't transfer certain information
